settings.statement: One piece, for one person, made once.
settings.text: Outside the numbered drops, the house makes single pieces to the wearer — wedding sets above all. Nothing here is listed or held in stock. It begins with a conversation with Kamalam and ends at the loom.

settings.left: The groom set · made for [wearer], [occasion, year]
settings.right: Woven by [weaver] · [loom hours] hours · gold zari

settings.title: The conversation
settings.text: Write to us with the occasion and the date. Kamalam replies within [n] days and, if the dates allow, a call is set. Tamil or English.

settings.title: Cloth and motif
settings.text: Together you settle the cloth, the border, the motif and the colour from the kara set. A sample of the border is woven and sent before anything is committed.

settings.title: The loom
settings.text: The veshti is woven by a named weaver at the unit. The kurta or shirt is cut to your measure. You are told when the warp goes on.

settings.title: Fitting and delivery
settings.text: One fitting, in [city] or by measurement. Delivered by hand within Tamil Nadu; insured courier elsewhere. The piece carries the weaver's name and yours.

settings.title: The wedding set
settings.text: Veshti, kurta and angavastram as one piece. Gold or tested zari, motifs drawn for the family. [Lead time] weeks. From ₹ [PRICE].
